description: This file defines dialog interfaces for list style customization in CKEditor, including functions for retrieving list elements, mapping list styles, and creating dialogs for bulleted and numbered list styles.

methods.name: getListElement
methods.description: Retrieves the list element (ul or ol) from the current selection in the editor.

methods.name: listStyle
methods.description: Creates dialog configuration for list style options, either bulleted or numbered.
